item.title: Ask HN: Interesting Tech Adjacent Jobs?
item.summary: Long story short, I am no longer interested in working in tech like I have been for the past 10 years. Fortunately after 10 years of working in tech I have a good amount of money saved up, enough to work part time or take a job that pays significantly less. I don’t mind writing software, I like technology and computers but I’m just really burned out from working high stress jobs for so long. Has anyone else made this transition to doing something else that is still in tech but not as stressful and AI driven? It doesn’t even have to be in tech at this point honestly, I’m just really ready for a change but it does feel like a little bit of a waste to not use all the skills I’ve been building writing software for so long. I’m really just looking for suggestions or examples of anything else people have done that might have found themselves in a similar position.
